name: Multi-level Sales
description:
The Multi-Level Sales app for Odoo provides a structured approach to sales team management, enabling businesses to organize their sales processes more efficiently. With this app, organizations can establish a hierarchical structure for their sales teams, assigning parent-child relationships to define clear access levels and responsibilities.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Parent-Child Relationship:**  
       - Create a hierarchical structure within sales teams, ensuring better organization and role distribution.  

    2) **Record Visibility:**  
       - Parent team members can access and manage sales records of child team members, improving oversight and tracking.  

    3) **New Access Rights for Team Leader:**  
       - Introduces a new access right, "Team Leader: Team Documents," allowing controlled data access within teams.  

    4) **Restricted Sales Record Access:**  
       - Team leaders can only view and manage their own team's records, preventing unauthorized access to other sales teams' data.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Sales Team Management:** Easily organize sales teams with clear hierarchy and defined responsibilities.  
    - **Access Control for Sales Data:** Restrict sales order visibility to the respective teams, enhancing data security.  
    - **Efficient Supervision:** Parent teams can monitor child team performance and ensure sales targets are met.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Settings → User (Assign Team Leader Group)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Configuration → Sales Team (Manage sales team hierarchy)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Quotations (View sales orders based on access rights)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Configuration → Sales Team (Assign parent teams)

name: Product Multiple Website
description:
The Product Multi Website module enhances Odoo's eCommerce capabilities by allowing businesses to assign multiple websites to a single product. This overcomes the default limitation of selecting only one website per product and improves control over product visibility. Products will only be displayed on selected websites, and the module introduces a customized field to assign multiple websites easily. Additionally, a mass update option lets users assign websites to multiple products simultaneously, saving time and improving productivity.  


    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Select Multiple Websites for Products:**  
       - Products can be assigned to more than one website, providing flexibility in managing product listings across multiple platforms.  

    2) **Mass Update for Multiple Products:**  
       - Quickly update the websites for a large number of products, improving efficiency.  

    3) **Control Product Visibility on Websites:**  
       - Products are displayed only on selected websites. If no websites are selected, they will be shown by default.  

    4) **Custom Website Field:**  
       - A custom field replaces the default website field, enabling multiple website selections for each product.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Multi-Website eCommerce:** Manage products across multiple websites to expand your online presence.  
    - **Product Visibility Control:** Limit product visibility to specific websites or channels based on sales strategies.  
    - **Bulk Product Management:** Quickly update and assign products to multiple websites without manual adjustments.  
    - **eCommerce Catalog Management:** Efficiently manage product listings across various eCommerce platforms.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Product → Sales → Websites (Select multiple websites for a product)  
    - **Navigation:** Product → Settings → Websites (View assigned websites for the product)  
    - **Navigation:** Products → Mass Update (Bulk update website assignments for products)

Sale line Description on MRP-Workorder and Picking
description:
The Sale Line Description on MRP-Workorder and Picking module enhances clarity in manufacturing and logistics by automatically transferring sales and purchase order line descriptions to related documents. It ensures that product descriptions from sales orders appear in delivery orders, Manufacturing Orders (MO), and MRP Workorders, while purchase order descriptions are included in picking receipts and delivery documents. This improves traceability, operational efficiency, and documentation accuracy.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Sale Order Line Description on Delivery Order:**  
       - Sales order line descriptions are automatically transferred to the delivery order lines.  

    2) **Sales Description on Manufacturing and Work Orders:**  
       - Sales order line descriptions are automatically carried over to the Manufacturing Order and Workorder.  

    3) **Purchase Order Line Description on Receipt:**  
       - Purchase order line descriptions are automatically included in the receipt document.  

    4) **Visible Descriptions in Picking Operations:**  
       - Sales and purchase order descriptions are displayed in stock picking operations.  

    5) **Print Descriptions in PDF Reports:**  
       - The transferred descriptions are included in picking operation PDF reports for better clarity.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Manufacturing & Production Planning:** Ensure accurate documentation of sales order descriptions in MOs and work orders.  
    - **Warehouse & Logistics:** Improve stock picking accuracy by including sales and purchase descriptions in delivery orders and receipts.  
    - **Procurement & Supply Chain:** Maintain clear communication between procurement, warehousing, and manufacturing teams.  
    - **Order Fulfillment & Customer Service:** Provide detailed product information in delivery and picking documents for smooth operations.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Orders → Sales Order (Sales Order Line Description is transferred)  
    - **Navigation:** Inventory → Operations → Delivery Orders (Sales Description is visible)  
    - **Navigation:** Inventory → Reporting → Delivery Order PDF (Sales Description is printed)  
    - **Navigation:** Manufacturing → Orders → Manufacturing Order (Sales Description is transferred)  
    - **Navigation:** Manufacturing → Work Orders (Sales Order Description is visible)  
    - **Navigation:** Purchase → Orders → Purchase Order (Purchase Order Line Description is transferred)  
    - **Navigation:** Inventory → Operations → Receipts (Purchase Description is visible)  
    - **Navigation:** Inventory → Reporting → Receipt PDF (Purchase Description is printed)
summary: The Sale Line Description on MRP-Workorder and Picking module ensures that sales and purchase order line descriptions are automatically transferred to Manufacturing Orders (MO), MRP Workorders, picking, receipt, and delivery orders. Odoo, by default, does not include product descriptions on incoming shipments, delivery orders, MOs, or Workorders, which can cause confusion in manufacturing and logistics operations. name: Sale Order Compare
description:
The Sale Order Compare module offers an efficient way to compare multiple sale orders in Odoo. With the help of an interactive pivot view, users can easily analyze sales data across various vendors and products. The pivot table presents detailed information, including product names, quantities sold, and subtotals. Users can filter the pivot view for a more in-depth comparison based on their specific needs. The module automates the comparison process, saving time and improving the accuracy of sales analysis.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Pivot View Comparison:**  
       - Compare multiple sale orders in a structured pivot view with detailed vendor-wise sales information.  

    2) **Automated Comparison:**  
       - The system automatically compares sale orders, eliminating the need for manual data comparison.  

    3) **Customizable Analysis:**  
       - The default view shows quantity and subtotal, but users can adjust filters for customized analysis of sales data.  

    4) **Quick Vendor and Product Comparison:**  
       - View how many products were sold by which vendor, enhancing your sales strategy and vendor relationships.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Sales Analysis:** Compare sales performance across vendors and products to identify top-selling items or underperforming products.  
    - **Vendor Performance Tracking:** Evaluate sales data by vendor to monitor performance and optimize vendor relations.  
    - **Business Intelligence:** Gain deeper insights into product sales, quantities, and subtotals to make informed business decisions.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Orders → Compare Sale Orders (Select orders for comparison)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Reports → Pivot View (Display detailed comparison of sale orders)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Reports → Filters (Adjust filters for customized analysis)

name: Website Birthday Discount
description:
The Website Birthday Discount module provides an automated birthday discount system for Odoo eCommerce, allowing businesses to reward loyal customers with special promotions on their birthdays. Customers can set their birthdate, and the system applies the discount automatically during checkout.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Automatic Birthday Discount:**  
       - Customers receive a discount on their birthday, applied automatically to the shopping cart.  

    2) **Secure Birthdate Entry:**  
       - Customers can enter their birthdate once, preventing multiple discounts within the same year.  

    3) **Admin-Controlled Birthdate Updates:**  
       - If a customer enters an incorrect birthdate, the admin can modify it from the backend.  

    4) **Visible Discount in Cart:**  
       - The applied discount is clearly displayed in the cart during checkout for transparency.  

    5) **Eligibility Restriction for Existing Customers:**  
       - Only customers with a prior purchase history are eligible for the birthday discount.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Retail & E-commerce Stores:** Increase customer engagement and encourage repeat purchases.  
    - **Loyalty Programs:** Reward loyal customers with exclusive birthday discounts.  
    - **Subscription-based Businesses:** Provide birthday perks to enhance customer satisfaction.  
    - **Multi-Vendor Marketplaces:** Offer unique discounts to customers from different vendors.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Settings → Define Discount Percentage (Admin sets discount rate)  
    - **Navigation:** Website → My Account → Edit Profile (Customer enters birthdate)  
    - **Navigation:** Website → eCommerce → Customers (Admin modifies incorrect birthdates)  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Shopping Cart (Discount is automatically applied on the customer’s birthday)

name: Purchase Order Template Product
description:
The Purchase Order Template Product module enhances procurement efficiency by allowing users to create and manage predefined product templates. These templates automatically populate purchase order lines with multiple products, sections, and notes, reducing manual effort and improving bulk purchase workflows. Ideal for businesses managing large-volume purchases, the module integrates with multiple Odoo functionalities, ensuring smooth procurement operations.

    Key Features:
    1) **Predefined Product Templates:**
       - Users can create custom templates containing multiple products, sections, and notes for faster purchase order processing.

    2) **Automated Purchase Order Population:**
       - When a product template is selected in a purchase order, all associated products are automatically added to the order lines.

    3) **Bulk Procurement Optimization:**
       - Ideal for businesses managing high-volume orders, reducing repetitive data entry and improving efficiency.

    4) **Seamless Integration with Odoo Modules:**
       - Works with Purchase Orders, Vendor Pricelists, Reordering Rules, Warehouse Management, and Procurement Planning.

    5) **Multi-Company and Multi-Currency Support:**
       - Facilitates global procurement processes by supporting multiple companies and currencies.

    Use Cases:
    - **Retail & Wholesale Businesses:** Quickly place bulk purchase orders using predefined templates.
    - **Manufacturing Companies:** Streamline procurement for production materials and inventory replenishment.
    - **E-commerce & Dropshipping:** Automate purchase orders with supplier product lists.
    - **Service Providers:** Manage recurring purchases with saved templates.

    Supported Views:
    - **Navigation:** Purchase → Purchase Template (To create and manage templates)
    - **Navigation:** Purchase → Purchase Orders (To use templates in purchase orders)
